findings.body: The new Postgres-backed case is added only to `test:hermetic`, but that case explicitly skips unless `WAREHOUSE_DB_TEST=1`. The `test:warehouse-proof` script—the suite that sets this variable—does not include `financial-data.service.test.ts`. Consequently the required functional lookup proof is always skipped in the registered suite, so SQL/schema regressions still pass. Add this test file to `test:warehouse-proof`.
findings.title: Not done: run the scoped warehouse lookup proof in the repository suite

findings.body: The revocation test removes the `report` action and calls `getCatalog`; it never changes the user's Plant grants or replays a previously valid `FinancialSelection`. Therefore removal of the `plantIds` subset check in `assertSelectionSupported` would leave this required test green, even though a selection pinned to a revoked Plant would then be accepted. Exercise a valid selection, change the resolved Plant scope, and assert that replay is denied.
findings.title: Not done: prove Plant-scope revocation denies the pinned selection

findings.body: The database-backed lookup case exercises only `gl`, `month`, and `cost_center`. It never executes the SQL for `plant`, `nursery_component`, `section`, `consideration`, `short_name`, `contra_account`, `origin`, or `location`. Those paths can contain invalid columns, joins, or active-batch predicates while all current tests pass, contrary to the requirement to cover every supported source dimension through the real warehouse seam.
findings.title: Not done: prove every advertised vocabulary dimension against Postgres

findings.body: The catalog publishes totals, every single-dimension grouping, and three multi-dimension groupings, but no test asserts that exact positive capability set. The two unsupported-grouping tests only detect adding those particular invalid combinations; deleting a required valid combination or changing a dimension's supported measures would still pass. Add an exact catalog assertion matching the coordinator-approved combinations and supported measure sets.
findings.title: Not done: prove the exact catalog combinations
